import urllib.request
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

def fetch_top_news():
    # Using BBC News RSS Feed as a reliable free source
    url = "http://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/rss.xml"
    
    headers = {
        'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)'
    }
    
    print("Fetching top news stories...\n")
    
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers)
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
            xml_data = response.read()
            
        root = ET.fromstring(xml_data)
        
        # Parse XML items (news articles)
        items = root.findall('.//item')
        
        for index, item in enumerate(items[:10], start=1):
            title = item.find('title').text if item.find('title') is not None else "No Title"
            description = item.find('description').text if item.find('description') is not None else ""
            link = item.find('link').text if item.find('link') is not None else ""
            
            print(f"{index}. {title}")
            if description:
                print(f"   Summary: {description}")
            if link:
                print(f"   Link: {link}")
            print("-" * 60)
            
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error fetching news: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    fetch_top_news()

def fetch_latest_news():

    url = "http://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/rss.xml"

    # Set a User-Agent header to prevent requests from being blocked
    req = Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})

    try:

        with urlopen(req) as response:

        # Parse the XML response

        # Extract and print top news items
        for index, item in enumerate(root.findall(".//item")[:5], 1):
            title = item.find("title").text
            link = item.find("link").text
            print(f"{index}. {title}")
            print(f"   Link: {link}\n")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An error occurred while fetching news: {e}")
